meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 给你的机器人加上 DeltaChat 渠道:消息通过邮箱收发并带 Autocrypt/OpenPGP 端到端加密,支持一对一私聊、群聊和文件附件,群里靠喊名字被点名回复。
howto.when: 当你按技能步骤把 DeltaChat 接入项目时接管:拉取 channels 分支、配好邮箱凭据、重启服务;启动后它会记录邀请链接,联系人需扫码或点链接才能发起对话。

say.text: 帮我启动 DeltaChat 渠道并打印邀请链接
say.note: 启动后日志写入邀请 URL,并生成二维码 SVG。

say.text: 把刚进来的 DeltaChat 私聊接到一个新 agent 上
say.note: 会创建 agent 组并给该用户 owner 权限。

say.text: 用 /set-avatar 把这张图设成机器人头像
say.note: 仅 owner 或全局 admin 可用。

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel: messages are sent and received over email with Autocrypt/OpenPGP encryption, supporting 1:1 chats, groups and file attachments; in groups it replies when addressed by name.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you run the skill to wire DeltaChat into the project (fetch the channels branch, set email credentials, restart the service); on startup it logs an invite link that contacts must open or scan.

say_en.text: Start the DeltaChat channel and print the invite link
say_en.note: Logs the invite URL and writes a QR SVG on startup.

say_en.text: Wire the new DeltaChat DM to a new agent
say_en.note: Creates the agent group and grants owner access.

say_en.text: Set this image as the bot avatar with /set-avatar
say_en.note: Only owner or global admin roles can use it.
